candidates.title: Daily sales by product (sales.daily_by_product)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of daily units_sold and revenue_eur per product_code; catalog grain daily, temporal coverage from 2022-01-01, last refreshed 2026-10-14, so both windows are in range.
candidates.found_via: search 'daily ice cream sales by product'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink till_migration_2024
suspected_issues: Wiki till_migration_2024 (last edited 2024-03-12): no sales recorded 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10; rows absent and must be treated as missing, not zero
Wiki product_codes_2024 (last edited 2024-04-02): codes changed from 2024-04-01; codes ending in 'L' replaced; no mapping table exists
No closed-day flag in this table; closed days only distinguishable via store.calendar
Refund/void treatment, timezone/cut-off and partial-day status of the recent export not documented in catalog

candidates.title: Product list (sales.products)
candidates.why_relevant: Product names and categories needed to match old and new codes by name, the only available route per wiki product_codes_2024.
candidates.found_via: search 'product code change 2024 mapping'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink product_codes_2024
suspected_issues: Lists only current codes (catalog and wiki product_codes_2024), so retired pre-2024 codes are absent
Not a mapping table; wiki says some names are not unique
Catalog last_refreshed 2025-03-31, refresh on change

candidates.title: Shop calendar (store.calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: Daily is_open flag and event_name for the shop; needed to separate closed days from zero-sales or missing days and to add local events.
candidates.found_via: search 'shop opening hours closed days Valdena'; get_catalog_entry
suspected_issues: Catalog temporal coverage starts 2022-01-01 with end null; row_count ~1500 approx, which should be checked against the window length
Refresh weekly; last refreshed 2026-10-10
No wiki backlinks; history of opening hours changes not documented
event_name completeness and whether events are historical rather than current is unknown
Not checked against sales rows for the 2024 till outage period

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Only register source for daily weather at a chosen Italian coordinate covering 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31.
suspected_issues: Register default_query uses hourly temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation with timezone UTC; no daily maximum temperature variable is listed as approved, so daily max is a coverage gap unless confirmed, otherwise hourly must be aggregated and flagged
No city in the spec; coordinate must be chosen and recorded in decisions.md (register default 45.4642, 9.1900 is Milan, not a justified shop location)
Reanalysis grid cell is coarser than the town
Probe calls must be kept to a few days

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Register source for national public holidays by year and country, covering 2023 to 2026 with country=IT.
suspected_issues: National holidays only; regional or patron-saint days in northern Italy are not covered and must be noted or sourced separately
Bridge days (ponte) not represented
Holidays on weekends confound the weekday effect
Terms are a GitHub link; prototyping and production approved per register
